name: Grumman G-164 Ag-Cat
summary: Single-engine agricultural biplane built by Grumman, then Schweizer; a purpose-built crop sprayer with the cockpit set high and aft behind a large hopper. Many have been re-engined with turbines.

wings: Biplane wing cell braced by interplane struts
Rounded wingtips, upper and lower wings of similar span
engines: Single radial engine in a round cowling (some with turbine conversions)
fuselage: High, aft-set single-seat cockpit with a raised canopy
tail: Conventional tail with a tall fin and rudder

tellTales: Biplane with a radial engine and a spraying hopper
High cockpit set well back behind the upper wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Ag-Cat is a single-seat sprayer with a hopper and a high rear cockpit; the Stearman is a trainer with two open cockpits and no hopper.
The Ag-Cat is a biplane; the Thrush is a monoplane.
The Ag-Cat is a biplane; the Air Tractor is a monoplane with a long single wing.
The Ag-Cat is a biplane with a radial; the Pawnee is a small, strut-braced monoplane with a flat engine.
